title: Conversation 2026-10-23: the zodiac, the trigram and a domain's axes

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: The owner on the decision compass as zodiac based and the three-axis structure as trigram based, poles and polarity, three orthogonal axes for a domain, and pulling strong work forward and recording it safely. This note is the conversation's identity record; the vignettes are the owner's words.
